title: Kachumber Salad

ingredients.title: For the Salad
items: Cucumber – 1 cup, peeled if desired, deseeded and finely diced
Tomato – 1 cup, firm, deseeded and finely diced
Red onion – ½ cup, finely diced
Fresh coriander leaves – 2 tbsp, finely chopped
Green chili – 1 small, deseeded and finely minced (optional)

ingredients.title: For the Dressing
items: Red chili powder or Kashmiri chili powder – ¼ tsp
Freshly ground black pepper – to taste

instruction.title: Prepare the Vegetables
steps: Deseed the cucumber and tomato to reduce excess moisture.
Dice the cucumber, tomato, and red onion into even pieces, approximately 5 mm cubes.
Add cucumber, tomato, onion, chopped coriander, and green chili to a mixing bowl.

instruction.title: Prepare the Dressing
steps: In a small bowl, combine lemon juice, roasted cumin powder, chili powder, black salt if using, regular salt, and freshly ground black pepper.
Whisk until the dressing is evenly combined.

instruction.title: Toss & Serve
steps: Pour the dressing over the vegetables immediately before serving.
Toss gently with a spoon until the vegetables are evenly coated.
Avoid overmixing so the diced vegetables retain their shape and crunch.

instruction.title: Plating
steps: Serve the salad in a chilled bowl or on a chilled plate.
Garnish with a fresh coriander sprig.
Finish with a light dusting of chaat masala if desired.

chefTips: Timing: Add the dressing immediately before serving to keep the vegetables crisp and prevent excess liquid.
Cumin: For the best flavor, dry roast whole cumin seeds over medium heat until aromatic, then grind into a powder.
Vegetables: Use firm tomatoes and fresh, crisp cucumbers for the best texture.
Presentation: Uniform 5 mm dice creates a clean, refined restaurant-style appearance.
Variations: Add grated carrot, diced radish, or pomegranate seeds for extra texture, color, and freshness.
